title: How a New Jersey Boutique Hotel Became the World Cup's Most Trusted Team Base
excerpt: The MC Hotel in Montclair has hosted four national teams during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, including Spain ahead of Sunday's final against Argentina at MetLife Stadium.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • The MC Hotel has hosted four World Cup teams during the 2026 tournament.
  • Spain's team reserved the entire hotel after their semifinal win over France.
  • The hotel underwent a year-long FIFA vetting process for security and accommodations.
  • Spain will compete against Argentina in the World Cup final on July 19.

  • The MC Hotel in Montclair, New Jersey, has hosted four World Cup teams — Germany, England, Norway, and now Spain — during the 2026 tournament.
  • Spain's team bus arrived on July 15 after its 2-0 semifinal win over France, with the entire hotel reserved for players, coaches, and families.
  • The hotel passed an "intensive" year-long FIFA vetting process covering security, staffing, and accommodations.
  • Spain faces Argentina in Sunday's World Cup final at MetLife Stadium, with kickoff at 3 p.m. ET.

When FIFA officials needed a secure, discreet base for World Cup teams playing at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, they kept returning to the same address: 690 Bloomfield Avenue, Montclair, New Jersey. The MC Hotel, a 156-room Autograph Collection property about 20 minutes from the stadium, has now hosted four national teams during the 2026 tournament — more than any other hotel in the New York-New Jersey metro area.

Spain Moves In for the Final

Team Spain arrived at the MC Hotel around 10:30 p.m. on July 15, the night after its 2-0 semifinal victory over France in Arlington, Texas. Goals from Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro sealed the win. The entire hotel has been reserved for the Spanish delegation — players, coaching staff, and families — through at least the final on July 19.

Owner Jeff Sica confirmed to NorthJersey.com that Spain is the fourth team to use the property during the World Cup, following Germany, England, and Norway. "It's a tremendous honor to have been chosen by FIFA," Sica said. "It's a tremendous honor to be given that level of trust."

How a Boutique Hotel Beat the Luxury Chains

The MC Hotel first appeared on FIFA's radar during the 2025 Club World Cup. After that initial engagement, the property underwent what Sica described as a "very intensive" year-long vetting process to determine whether it met the standards required for the full-scale World Cup — proper security infrastructure, adequate staffing, and accommodations suitable for elite athletes preparing for the biggest matches of their careers.

The hotel's repeated selection is notable in a metro area dominated by larger chain properties. While hotels near MetLife Stadium have been charging upward of $2,300 per night for the final weekend — and in some cases struggling with low occupancy despite the markup — the MC Hotel filled its rooms with the one client that matters most to FIFA: the teams themselves.

Sunday's Final: Spain vs. Argentina

Spain will face Argentina at MetLife Stadium — temporarily renamed New York New Jersey Stadium for the tournament — with kickoff at 3 p.m. ET on Sunday, July 19. Luis de la Fuente's squad has conceded just one goal in the entire tournament and has been training at the Gotham Training Facility in nearby New Jersey.

Argentina, the defending Copa America champions and 2022 World Cup winners, were briefly delayed in Atlanta by thunderstorms before traveling to New York. Lionel Messi and his teammates are expected to be based elsewhere in the metropolitan area.

What Fans Should Know

For the thousands of Indian diaspora soccer fans in the tri-state area, the final represents the culmination of five weeks of matches across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. MetLife Stadium has hosted eight matches during the tournament. Fans arriving for Sunday's final should note that walking to the stadium from nearby hotels is prohibited — shuttle services and rideshares are the primary transport options on match days.
